entry.title: MPC Looper 0.6.1
entry.summary: MPC Looper is a four-loop stereo looper for live performance and production on MPC Standalone. Record on the MPC beat/bar grid, overdub layers, follow the global tempo with Sync/Warp, and export each loop as a separate WAV. - ARMv7 hard-float (Gen1) and AArch64 (Gen2), MPC OS **3.10.1+** with External Plugin Support. - Recording quantization: **Off / Beat / Bar**; Free or 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32 bars. - Four loops, default recording length **4 bars**, maximum **32 bars**; overdub, undo/redo, indiv
